verdict.rationale: Navan's developer portal documents an OAuth 2.0 client-credentials REST API covering transactions (card, connect card, manual expenses), receipts, custom fields, and webhooks, per navan-docs-2 and navan-docs-4. This directly matches the developer story of pulling transactions/expenses/receipts via a scoped OAuth REST API. missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of the API in practice (e.g., third-party integration reports) and explicit detail on token scoping granularity.
